channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump tells South Korea to sign on to Alaska LNG deal or 'I'll just charge them more'
item.description: Trump is ramping up pressure on South Korea over Alaska LNG as Seoul remains cautious over investment projects announced by the U.S. president.

item.title: Surging Treasury yields don’t signal a U.S. 'fiscal apocalypse' — yet
item.description: Treasury yields above 5% are raising fears that higher borrowing costs could fuel a debt spiral.

item.title: The 2029 tipping point: Western populations are about to start shrinking, piling pressure on public finances
item.description: Moody's predicts that the world's aging populations will have fundamental impacts on the global economy and lead to difficult policy decisions.

item.title: Stock futures are flat as investors grapple with higher yields, await Fed minutes: Live updates
item.description: Stocks are coming off a week defined by surging Treasury yields and a surprisingly weak jobs report that helped ease concerns about another Fed rate hike.

item.title: Russia hospitalizes almost 200 people after researcher's death from plague: Reports
item.description: Nearly 200 people are under medical observation in Russia’s Irkutsk region over suspected exposure to plague, according to local media reports.

item.title: ‘Unwelcome and unsafe’: Why Japanese companies are retreating from China at a historic rate
item.description: Japanese companies are leaving China at record pace, as a diplomatic freeze and a slowing economy force businesses to reassess their presence.

item.title: Trump reiterates pledge to send $5,000 checks, and hands out smaller payments, as midterm elections loom
item.description: Trump is promoting two federal payment programs already underway while reiterating a $5,000 dividend promise contingent on Republicans retaining Congress.

item.title: All U.S. bombers leave UK air base on concerns of suspected terror plots; more tankers struck near Iran in the Middle East
item.description: Tehran's conditions include a halt to U.S. "acts of aggression," an end to the naval blockade and economic warfare, and the release of Iranian assets.

item.title: They survived World War II and lost decades, but not 2026. Japan's century-old businesses are disappearing at a record pace
item.description: Japan’s century-old businesses face mounting pressures from rising costs, labor shortages, a shrinking market and succession challenges.

item.title: Supreme Court Justice Alito said he's 'thought about' retirement as Senate control hangs in balance
item.description: The Senate could flip to Democrats after November's midterm election, jeopardizing a potential Supreme Court nomination by President Donald Trump.

item.title: Starting a watch collection? What beginners should know before buying
item.description: Watch experts explain how beginners can start a collection, what tends to hold value, when to buy used and how to avoid costly mistakes.

item.title: High mortgage rates are trapping homeowners in place, and making renovations harder to afford
item.description: Homeowners are stuck in houses they might have left by now due to the low mortgage rates of the past, and can't even remodel with HELOCs too expensive to tap.

item.title: Brazil election headed to runoff, projection shows, as Bolsonaro lead narrows
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro led Brazil’s first-round presidential vote as more than half the ballots were counted, with Datafolha projecting a runoff.

item.title: Why brands like E.l.f., Wendy's and Gap are branching out into original music
item.description: E.l.f. Beauty released an album titled "Mirror Mix" as the brand plans to increase its marketing spend for the rest of the year.

item.title: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z. Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
item.description: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.

item.title: JPMorgan’s best stock ideas heading into October
item.description: JPMorgan has pointed to several investment ideas its analyst like for October. They include American Express, Thermo Fisher Scientific and Liberty Energy.

item.title: Goldman Sachs says buy these stocks now, ahead of their earnings
item.description: The firm said this week that it sees several quality buying opportunities ahead of companies' quarterly reports.

item.title: A 'weird' IPO pull, a tainted reputation and the stalled breakout moment for AI wearables
item.description: Apple, Google and Meta are pushing new AI devices and assistants amid growing privacy concerns around wearables.

item.title: Novig credits Sydney Sweeney-backed campaign for platform’s surge in growth
item.description: Novig's "Just Sports" campaign drew backlash from some female athletes but also brought in a rush of trading volume.

item.title: Ukraine’s surprise robot offensive exposes a vulnerability in Putin’s war machine
item.description: Experts say the offensive is not a decisive breakthrough, but demonstrates how Ukraine’s expanding use of robotic systems is reshaping frontline warfare.

item.title: It's time for us to put cash to work in this ugly market. Here's where we will do our buying
item.description: In his Sunday column, Jim Cramer explains why investors need to hold their nose and do some buying.

item.title: How to get a car loan, from prequalification to approval
item.description: Checking your credit, shopping around and understanding your financing terms can help you make a more informed decision when getting a car loan.

item.title: Trump taps Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as AI czar
item.description: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton will lead the administration's AI policy.

item.title: In crude Ohio rally speech, Trump says he may not help if Democrats win
item.description: Ohio's is among eight U.S. Senate races rated competitive. The state has turned into a campaign battlefield over data centers and culture war issues.

item.title: Chick-fil-A wants to stay a family business even as it expands in the U.S. and abroad
item.description: Chick-fil-A has been expanding into new international markets and growing its menu under CEO Andrew Cathy.

item.title: Top Wall Street analysts are upbeat about the prospects for these 3 stocks
item.description: Investors with a long-term horizon can track ratings from top Wall Street analysts to find stocks with solid growth prospects.

item.title: Yemeni government launches offensive to seize all areas from Iran-backed Houthis
item.description: Yemen's government said it was launching a major military campaign to recapture all areas of the country controlled by the Iran-backed Houthis.

item.title: OPEC+ agrees to keep November oil output targets steady
item.description: Gulf OPEC+ producers have been pumping well below output targets in the face of continuing export disruptions from the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: This NYC startup requires 4 days in office but just let everyone work remote for a whole month
item.description: SolComms, a New York City-based PR firm, says letting employees work from anywhere in the world boosted revenue, productivity and happiness.

item.title: High-tech vehicles are driving up auto repair costs for shops and consumers
item.description: Investments in ADAS calibration equipment, computers and software subscriptions can drive up the cost of even a windshield replacement or an oil change.
